name: 对战战场
body: SCREEN 04 对战战场. A readable stable player turn, not a menu. Broad horizontal tactical board with two separated battlefield rows. Opponent portrait top: 生命16, PP0/5; player portrait bottom-left: 生命18, PP3/5. Center small 第5回合 / 我方回合. Opponent row has 2 followers; player row has 3 followers including selected 星辰引路者 3/2/4, and a separate hand of 5 distinct cards along bottom. Leave adequate open space between rows; every card face legible. Right action zone: prominent 结束回合, secondary 进化 and PP+1. Left narrow selected-card preview shows the same card 3/2/4 with short description; only one subtle targeting arc, no explosion. Both deck/hand resource counts and evolution indicators stay close to their portraits. Top-left 返回 / 投降; small 表情 and 桌布 affordances. No copied huge home wordmark, orbital navigation or character poster. Board uses the observatory's engraved orbital stone, but gameplay dominates.
